falsifiable_hypothesis: A corrupt or missing artifact is refused at ingestion and routed to recovery rather than accepted.

fault_classes.observed_behaviour: refused with a read-back mismatch error, classified RECOVERY_REQUIRED, capsule intact, rerun from the capsule reached PARENT_INGESTED
a byte count one higher than the committed bytes was enough on its own to produce a read-back mismatch and RECOVERY_REQUIRED; rerun reached PARENT_INGESTED
the artifact was truncated by five bytes and re-committed while the result kept the original hash; refused with a read-back mismatch and RECOVERY_REQUIRED; rerun reached PARENT_INGESTED
refused with a read-back failure, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, event chain still verifiable, rerun reached PARENT_INGESTED
a forty-zero commit id was refused with a read-back failure and RECOVERY_REQUIRED; rerun reached PARENT_INGESTED
git cat-file blob refused the tree locator, so ingestion refused with a read-back failure and RECOVERY_REQUIRED; rerun reached PARENT_INGESTED
a file:// locator was refused as non-durable; read_object_bytes also raised ValueError for http:// and for a bare relative path

overwriting the worktree file with different bytes after the commit changed nothing: ingestion read the committed object, matched the recorded hash and byte count, and reached PARENT_INGESTED with zero errors
fault_classes.note: this class asserts the opposite direction on purpose; it is the property that makes hash coverage meaningful

fault_classes.observed_behaviour: a zero-byte artifact was refused by the seeded contract with '$.artifacts[0].bytes: must be an integer >= 1' and an artifact-free committed result with '$.artifacts: committed result requires at least one artifact'; both classified RECOVERY_REQUIRED

residual_findings.detail: ingest_result carries its own guard for an artifact-free result ('result carries no artifacts; nothing durable to ingest'), but the seeded contract rejects that document first, so the guard is unreachable for a committed result.
residual_findings.impact: none on custody: the document is refused either way and classified RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Recorded so the guard is not mistaken for the active check.

residual_findings.detail: a refused result is still written to control/tasks/<task>/result-<hash>.json alongside its ingestion record.
residual_findings.impact: this is what makes the refusal auditable and hash-covered; it is recorded as observed behaviour rather than as a fault.
